answer_1.quote: In this study, we address the challenge of minimizing misgendering across 42 languages ... test them in a meeting transcript summarization context.
datasets: Synthetic meeting transcript dataset (20 gold transcripts per language)

answer_2.quote: We establish two metrics to identify instances of misgendering, along with one quality metric ... Gender Mistake (GM): Binary metric ... Gender Assumption (GA): Binary metric ... Quality (Q): A ternary metric between 0-2.

answer_3.quote: We use both LLM-and human-based evaluation techniques ... For LLM-based evaluation, we use GPT-4o, Phi-3.5-MoE-Instruct and Qwen-25-vl7b as judges. We conduct both individual assessments ... and Side-By-Side (SBS) evaluations.

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation was done by three native speakers per language. They were requested to evaluate the model's output with the same metrics (GM, GA, Q).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rated each summary on the three metrics: Gender Mistake (GM), Gender Assumption (GA), and Quality (Q).
